answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a foundational reef for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to solve a Turing test tethered to a biometric atlas. This mechanism forces attackers to incur high capital costs for identity fabrication, effectively turning the network environment into a desert dune where computational mass alone cannot yield influence without verifiable human-linked uniqueness. Validated participants maintain network integrity by raising the barrier for malicious ingress through scarce physical proof.
